_readme: 機械化驗證合約：巡檢逐條以 bash 執行 cmd，依 expect 判定；只報告失敗項。expires 過期未續約即刪除。維護：巡檢可增刪，新增必附 added 日期。

contracts.desc: 艦隊記憶快照每日更新且推雲
pid.json 外零 daemon 進程（§9）
contracts.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const reg=new Set();for(const d of fs.readdirSync('D:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/autodev-ng/data')){try{reg.add(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('D:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/autodev-ng/data/'+d+'/daemon.lock/pid.json','utf8')).pid)}catch{}};const out=execSync('powershell -NoProfile -Command \"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \\\"Name='node.exe'\\\" | Where-Object { \$_.CommandLine -match 'cli.js daemon' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId\"',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);const orph=out.filter(p=>!reg.has(p));if(orph.length){console.log('孤兒:'+orph.join(','));process.exit(1)}console.log('OK')"
